Thanks — looping in a short implementation plan and attachments for the kickoff. High level: 

Sprint 0 (pre-kickoff, due Aug 6):
- Confirm signed SOW and PO.
- Network allowlist and IPs exchanged.
- Customer provides sample dataset (anonymized).
- Redwood shares data flow one-pager and retention controls.

Sprint 1 (integration, Aug 9 - Sep 3):
- Devs ingest sample dataset, run connectivity tests.
- KV cache sizing and throughput targets agreed.
- End-to-end integration test in staging.

Sprint 2 (validation, Sep 6 - Sep 17):
- Performance testing against expected QPS.
- Security review completed, signed acceptance.

Cutover week (target Sep 20):
- Production switch, post-cutover stabilization window (2 weeks).

Attachments included: integration_checklist.xlsx, kickoff_agenda.docx. Emma / Rajesh — I've added a short data-flow one-pager in the Drive link (see related links). Ben — once you confirm the Aug 5 kickoff time I'll send the calendar invite and include owners for each agenda line.

Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: integration_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet), kickoff_agenda.docx (DOCX, 2 pages)]
